memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Avery explicitly chose an early departure only for this trip because additional preparation time outweighed later-day timing; the choice applied solely to the disrupted Monday outbound.

messages.content: Southwest changed Monday’s outbound to an evening flight that lands after 9:00 p.m. I need enough time before the 8:00 a.m. museum start Tuesday. What can they move me to without changing Thursday’s Delta return?

Because the schedule change is substantial, Southwest is offering either a refund or a one-time move to another Monday Southwest flight at no additional fare. The remaining nonstop choices are 7:10 a.m.-8:00 a.m. and 10:35 a.m.-11:25 a.m. Your suitcase and supply case remain included. Delta DL 1284 on Thursday and the Cheshire reservation are separate and would not be affected.
Is there anything later than 10:35 that still gets me there with useful preparation time?

Delta has a nonstop leaving Atlanta at 1:05 p.m. and arriving in St. Louis at 1:55 p.m. It would be a new ticket costing $64 more than the value returned by Southwest, plus $35 to check the supply case. With ground travel, you would likely reach the Cheshire around 3:00 p.m. Southwest has no other workable earlier departure; its next flight is the changed evening service.
So the Southwest choices cost nothing to change and still include both bags, while Delta adds $99 overall?

Correct. The 7:10 a.m. and 10:35 a.m. Southwest options are both no-cost exchanges and retain the included carry-on and checked supply case. Moving to Delta would add $64 in airfare and $35 for the checked case, for $99 more.
For this trip, use the 7:10 a.m. flight even though it is early. The extra setup time matters more. Replace only Monday’s outbound and leave Thursday exactly as booked.
Understood. I’ll exchange the disrupted Southwest segment for the 7:10 a.m. Monday departure and make no changes to Delta DL 1284 on Thursday or the hotel.
Go ahead, and confirm the final times and baggage after the exchange.

The exchange is complete at no additional charge. New outbound: Southwest WN 2064 on Monday, October 12, departing ATL at 7:10 a.m. and arriving STL at 8:00 a.m.; confirmation L8Q2RM remains the same. Your carry-on and checked supply case are included. Thursday’s Delta DL 1284 remains unchanged, departing STL at 4:15 p.m. and arriving ATL at 6:48 p.m. under H6T9VK. The Cheshire booking for October 12-15 is also unchanged.
